label: rem:categorical-mass-positivity
title: Structural positivity of categorical mass and action
html:
The categorical mass evaluates the observation functor \tau on graded projective KLR modules. The functor takes the graded Euler characteristic, rendering each coefficient the non-negative integer dimension of a \mathrm{Hom}-space:

  [\tau(\mathfrak{M}_K)]_d \;=\;
  \dim_R \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{K}_n}\bigl(P_d, \mathfrak{M}_K\bigr)
  \;\in\; \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}.

The polynomial \tau(\mathfrak{M}_K) is the mass-spectrum generating function. Each coefficient corresponds to the microstate degeneracy of a graded Hecke energy level. The resulting mass formula remains structurally positive by categorical definition.
